curricula.name: Egyptian MOE national curriculum, from official student books
curricula.note: Units and lessons copied from the contents pages of Ministry of Education and Technical Education student books hosted on the Ministry's e-learning storage. Topic titles are the book's own headings; English titles are our translations. Generic items (speaking practice, lesson and unit assessments, reviews) are left out.

verified.method: Read from the contents page of each linked Ministry student book; cover checked for Ministry branding, grade, and academic year.
